text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp has arrived!
Even Rulership, who despises the outdoors, is giving it her all.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, right? This is just setting up the board for the future.
If it's necessary, I'll grind out as much as it takes.
choice_data_list: That's what I like to hear...!

text_block_list.text:
"Let's make sure you gain serious ground this summer!"
While we were discussing our next training session...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Ruler and Trainer! Did you hear about the summer festival?
They're holding one at the shrine nearby starting this evening~♪

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ...A festival, you say?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Not bad.
I don't care for crowds, but it is a rare occasion.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Besides... sharing a summery experience with Trainer
would make our relationship utterly rock-solid.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Perfect timing on that intel.
With this flow, naturally...!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, the whole class was talking about going together!
Wanna come too, Ruler?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
With everyone, huh... Sorry, but I'll pass.
Thanks for the invite, though.
choice_data_list: (Is she not interested in festivals...?)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...As you know, I don't handle noisy crowds well.
If only we could stroll around in a small group, nice and slow...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(And by clearly laying out the conditions like that, they're sure
to offer the simplest solution... "Then let's just go, the two of us"...!)
choice_data_list: I see...
I see...

text_block_list.text:
She did get overwhelmed by crowds the other day.
Today's training load was heavy, so she probably just wants to rest up early.
choice_data_list: Well, shall we get back to training?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh? ...Wh-What?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! That marks today's tasks as complete,
but still...
choice_data_list: Great work today!

text_block_list.text:
She had an incredible run!
Eager to analyze the data, my mind was already racing ahead.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's call it a day! See you tomorrow!
Alright, let's wrap up for today! See you tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Huh, hey?! That was fast?!
Wait a—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Whaaaaaat the heeeeeell?!
Why does it always end up like thiiiiiis?!)

That night, as I sat typing away on my laptop,
I noticed Rulership staring at me with a sour expression.
choice_data_list: Hm? Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
No... I'm just concerned about you overworking.
Can't have my right-hand collapsing on me.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Working non-stop since noon will only tank your efficiency.
It's about time you took a breather.
choice_data_list: A breather, huh. Mmm, good point...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Hey, why aren't you getting it... Did you seriously forget the festival entirely?!
Ugh, this wasn't in the calculations...!)

Rulership kept glaring at me discontentedly.
Then, an idea hit me.
choice_data_list: Wait, were you looking for someone to play games with?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Not that...! Think along more logical lines!
Why aren't you getting it...?!
choice_data_list: U-Umm...?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Look, earlier today... during training.
Didn't anything catch your attention?
choice_data_list: During training? Wait... you're not injured, are you?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Grrrrhhhhh...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Hahaha... What is this? Your unique passive ability?
"Immune to all damage unless hit head-on," or something like that?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaargh! That does it!
THE! SUM-! MER! FES-! TI-! VAL!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The festival! I've been saying let's go together!
You idioooot!!
choice_data_list: W-Whaaat?! But why all of a sudden...?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Wh-Why, you ask...?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Do I really need a reason...?
Are you only interested in my running and gameplays...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's not a festival... it's about making memories...
Before it's a camp, it's summer break...! Let's go together! Pleeease~!

Her unexpected outburst left me stunned.
I was completely convinced she had no interest. If that was the case...
choice_data_list: You should've just told me straight up!

text_block_list.text:
And so, I shut my laptop and we headed to the summer festival!
As for Rulership...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Ooh, it really does feel like summer...

Seeing how happy she looked brought a smile to my face.
However, Rulership still seemed slightly self-conscious.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Was this really okay?
You were in the middle of working.
choice_data_list: Yeah, of course!
Yup, of course!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Good grief... What a massive blind spot.
choice_data_list: Blind spot?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The objective: wasn't "tactics."
Since you're on my side of the board, what I needed was "briefing the plan."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yet I kept making useless moves instead...
Just like the other day, with that whole...
choice_data_list: The other day...?

text_block_list.text:
Hearing that brought the events of the other day back to mind.
Could it be, it wasn't just today...?
choice_data_list: (Was that what she meant back then, too...?)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
choice_data_list: Ruler, can I ask you something frankly?
Ruler, can I ask you something frankly?

text_block_list.text:
And so, we decided to move to a quieter spot.
I wanted to properly listen to and accept what she was feeling...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Oho... So this is a strategy meeting, then?
To build our future rapport.

Things got twisted up because I failed to notice her hints.
Even so, if she wants to, I'd like for us to communicate more openly.
choice_data_list: Even if there's no official reason, talk to me whenever!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ...Do you really mean that?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you just tagging along out of obligation because I'm your trainee?
Deep down, aren't you thinking, "Man, she's such a pain"?
choice_data_list: All of that is part of who you are.
All of that is part of who you are.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Doesn't that basically mean I *am* annoying...?
That's the worst...! Aaaaah, you really *do* hate it, don't youuu?!
choice_data_list: You're not annoying, and I don't hate it.

text_block_list.text:
That's simply who the horsegirl Rulership is.
I told her that I'm fully prepared to accompany her through all of it.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What kind of benefit could that possibly have for you... Wait, my running... right?
Y-You're just totally head over heels for my talent, aren't you~? You really are...
choice_data_list: Exactly!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...!
W-Well, horsegirls of my caliber don't come around often, after all.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
So even if you're jerked around a bit, you simply cannot walk away.
If that is the case, then I suppose it is logically sound.
choice_data_list: Precisely!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Very well. I accept your resolve.
In that case, you will accompany me to the bitter end.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: All the way to the endgame... woven across the board by my races!
choice_data_list: (Thank goodness! She's back to her old self!)

text_block_list.text:
Rulership truly is a complicated horsegirl...
Yet what she says isn't far off—no, it isn't wrong at all—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
That concludes our strategy meeting, then. Consensus achieved.
You, too... should feel free to speak up whenever you wish to see me.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
For a capable right-hand partner, making time
is certainly no great imposition on my part. Understood?

—Because the fact that I'm completely captivated
by her running is undeniable!
